Download **Thermal-Setup-1.0.0.exe** for the easiest setup on Windows 10/11 (Intel/AMD x64).

1. Run the installer and approve the Windows permission prompt.
2. Leave the desktop-shortcut and temperature-sensor options enabled.
3. Open Thermal from the desktop or Start menu.

The installer includes the signed PawnIO sensor prerequisite. Thermal itself is not code-signed yet, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher/reputation prompt. Check that the file came from this repository's release and compare its checksum with SHA256SUMS.txt before proceeding.

Prefer a portable copy? Extract all of **Thermal-windows-x64.zip**, then open **Start Thermal.exe**. First run offers sensor setup if needed.

Live PC readings, an always-on-top mini monitor, local seven-day history, and CSV export. Closing the window keeps monitoring in the tray; opening Thermal again restores the dashboard.
